title: Interior and Exterior Appearance
summary: Reviews in this topic mainly discuss the G60’s interior and exterior appearance and cabin feel, with many fragments too brief or ambiguous to determine sentiment.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the car’s interior and exterior styling, workmanship, cabin feel, and color choices.

negative.summary: Negative reviews mention disappointment with interior color or finish and discomfort with the seats.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments often mention the inside, space, heat, or inside-versus-outside contrast without enough context to confirm a clear sentiment.

limitations: A large share of fragments are too short or vague to classify beyond mentioning the interior or inside/outside comparison.
This topic includes loosely related mentions of styling, cabin feel, interior space, trunk space, and heat intrusion rather than one tightly focused issue.
